jobDescription: A mutual insurer is rebuilding its claims journey around a set of internal APIs. The tech lead runs a team of six engineers, makes and records the team's technical decisions, holds release sign-off for the team's services, leads incident response for them and works with application security on remediation. As the team grows the tech lead will also be expected to lead its hiring, including setting the hiring plan with the engineering manager. The team sits within the claims technology group, reports to the engineering manager and works with claims operations and application security.
requirements: Has been tech lead for an engineering team, holding technical decisions and release sign-off for its services.
Designs and versions REST APIs for insurance products.
Leads incident response and writes post-incident reviews.
Works with application security to remediate vulnerabilities.
Has led hiring for an engineering team, including setting the hiring plan.

evidence.text: Software engineer from 2019, then tech lead from 2022 to 2024, on the claims API team at Pemberton Mutual, a team of six engineers.
Designed the first-notice-of-loss API and its versioning scheme, recording each choice in an architecture decision record that the candidate wrote and the team accepted.
Acted as incident commander for two severity-one outages in 2023 and wrote both post-incident reviews, naming an owner and a deadline for each corrective action.
Worked with the application-security team to clear 41 dependency vulnerabilities flagged by the scanner, spreading the fixes over three sprints and recording each fix in the remediation tracker.
Sat on interview panels for four engineering hires, assessing the system-design exercise and writing the panel's feedback for the engineering manager.

Work sample: the architecture decision record for the first-notice-of-loss API versioning scheme, showing the options considered, the decision taken, the candidate as author and the date the team accepted it.

Reference check summary: the former head of engineering confirmed in writing that the candidate was tech lead for the claims API team from March 2022 to May 2024 and held merge approval and release sign-off for its services during that period.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can attend the technical interview in the week of 21 October and would like to meet the current team before the final stage.
